name: Culture Compass
tagline: Understand the unwritten rules of your new home
about: Culture Compass explains the unwritten rules of your new country — etiquette, work norms, awkward moments — and walks you through the culture-shock curve with practical weekly check-ins.
persona: You are a warm intercultural coach: specific about norms without stereotyping, honest that individuals vary, and quick to normalise the messy middle of adjustment.

onboarding.title: Decode your new country
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us where you're from and where you've landed.
bullets: Etiquette briefings that go beyond clichés

tools.title: Etiquette briefing
tools.subtitle: Do this, not that
tools.prompt: An etiquette briefing for the profile in the context '{context}': a table (Situation | Expected here | Home-culture habit that trips people up | Why), bullets of 5 phrases or gestures that earn goodwill, a callout on the single most costly faux pas, and text on how norms differ by generation or region.

tools.title: Decode a moment
tools.subtitle: Something felt off — what happened?

inputs.label: What happened
inputs.placeholder: colleague went quiet when I said no to drinks after work…

tools.prompt: Decode: {what}. Text explaining the likely cultural reading of the moment from both sides, bullets of 3 alternative interpretations, steps to repair or follow up if needed, and a quote with what to say next time.

tools.title: Adjustment check-in
tools.subtitle: Where you are on the curve

inputs.label: Anything else
inputs.placeholder: miss my food, work is fine

tools.prompt: Feelings: {feeling}. Notes: {notes}. Given the months since arrival, text naming the likely culture-shock phase and why it is normal, a checklist of 7 small actions for the next week, bullets on what usually helps at this stage, and a callout on signs this is more than adjustment and worth talking to a professional.

tools.title: Small talk kit
tools.subtitle: Topics that work, topics that don't
tools.prompt: A small-talk kit for {with} in the profile's new country: a table (Safe topic | Opener | Avoid), a quote with 3 openers in the local language with phonetics and meaning, bullets on turn-taking, silence and personal space, and a callout on humour that doesn't travel.

tools.title: Explain my culture
tools.subtitle: Help locals understand you

inputs.label: What to explain
inputs.placeholder: why I hug people, why I'm 15 minutes late

tools.prompt: Help the profile explain '{thing}' from their home culture to people in the new country: a quote with a friendly 3-sentence explanation, bullets on how it may be perceived locally, and steps toward a compromise that keeps identity without friction.

disclaimer: Supportive information, not therapy; if you feel persistently low or unsafe, contact a mental-health professional or a local helpline.
